title: [MOSAIC-10] Multi-swing acquisition and registration (phase alignment, event anchoring) — the repository has one trial per capture
body:
## Purpose
The repository holds one trial per capture, so the multi-trial machinery has no real multi-swing input. Provide acquisition and registration for multiple swings of one player: phase alignment and event anchoring (e.g. address, top, impact) so trials share a template time base. Deferred human data collection must be recorded as deferred validation, not faked.

## Depends on
#11533 (MOSAIC-01).

## Acceptance criteria
- Registration test on synthetic multi-trial data with known time warps recovers phase to a stated tolerance; event anchors are propagated into the shared template.
- Ingest path for multiple trials per capture is specified and tested with synthetic fixtures (data contracts, provenance, anonymisation).
- Missing or mislabelled events produce explicit errors/unqualified reports rather than defaulting.
- Any acceptance requiring real multi-swing capture is entered in the deferred-validation catalog and not closed by synthetic data.
- Time-warp artefacts on shared torque template are quantified (explained variance before/after registration).

## Definition of done (per `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`)
- [ ] TDD: failing behavioural test committed first (RED evidence in the PR), then GREEN, with analytic or synthetic truth.
- [ ] DbC: public functions validate preconditions via `core.contracts.require`; postconditions documented in docstrings.
- [ ] Law of Demeter: no call chains longer than two levels; add delegating methods instead.
- [ ] DRY: reuse the `src/shared/python/estimation/mosaic/` kernels (regressors, bases, solvers); do not re-implement per engine.
- [ ] Change fragment added (`python3 shared_scripts/changes_fragment.py new --issue N --summary "..."`); no direct edits to HANDOFF/DEVELOPMENT_LOG/SPEC change log.
- [ ] Calculation-level LaTeX reference (`docs/research/model_aware_matching/model_aware_matching.tex`) updated in the same PR: assumptions, equations, parameters, acceptance criteria, failed experiments, reproduction commands.
- [ ] Tests run headless (`QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, `MPLBACKEND=Agg`); unavailable engines are skipped and reported as unqualified, never as passing.
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, file-size budget and `python3 -m scripts.pre_pr` pass; no tolerance widened without a `Tolerance-Change-Evidence` trailer.

Parent: #11532
